title: January actually feels like a year ago #januaryrecap #theatrerecap #t...
transcript: It's time for a January theater recap! Yes, I know it's almost March, but I've seen too many shows to combine them. But don't. Don't worry, February is being posted right after this. A play I've tried twice and never need to see again. Love choose your own ending. Not my kind of humor, but the improv was top notch. A thrilling night at the theater, even with a no fly show. Both hilarious and thought provoking look at accessibility. Heartbreaking and masterfully directed. A fever dream. Also a fever dream for entirely different reasons. So much better than before. Poignant and timely. Stunning performances in a show not for me. Not at all what I was expecting in the best possible way. Looking forward to seeing more from these artists. One last time at the Corn Show until the tour. Love slapstick that also has character building. Hilarious. One of my fave new plays. This cast. It's like a new show. Like three plays rolled into one. Putting the superstar and Jesus Christ Superstar. Not all visions work, but that's okay. This is my church at its best. Incredibly heartwarming. A journey that hooked me in by the end. Went to second time. Still ultimately not for me. The perfect kind of encore show. Incredible movement and storytelling. The Jimmy Awards N54 below. Two of my favorite things. My favorite new JRB score since parade look, it really is that good. More Joe Lock on Broadway, please.
